blurb: Drive-in tent-only campsiteShaded underneath an oak canopy on the outskirts of pine flatwoods, this popular tent-only campsite has a covered pavilion with a picnic table and ample space for several tents.Located at 4500 Dallas Blvd., Orlando, the Hal Scott Regional Preserve and Park is in the Wedgefield neighborhood, between state roads 520 and 528.
